rationale: M14 master-review wave (2026-09), verified on rake + rack at 100%/0/0. RUBD12: hash/argument pair VALUES are real expressions — colon `{ key: fetch_key }`, rocket `{ pair => fetch_val }`, and keyword-argument `store.write(cache: build_entry)` values must emit their method calls (the `pair` skip-parent silently suppressed them on BOTH analyzer and oracle — a shared blind spot F5 cannot see); local values (`{ z: local_val }`) stay silent. Dynamic superclass (RUBD13/RB-C): `class Tuple < Struct.new(:a,:b)` emits NO extends (anonymous base) while the Struct.new call surfaces as instantiates:Struct; static superclasses (`Child < Base`) keep extends. Keyword `alias` at declaration scope is alias_method's twin (RB-E contract): calls:copy with aliasedTo:original. Reopen identity (RUBD13): `class M::Inner` carries the SAME identity as the nested `module M; class Inner` (name Inner, owner M — fqn recorded in metadata), so cross-file reopen spellings unify.
